text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon puts on a dominant display. 
Her true strength is steadily winning over 
the public.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Brian was sure to claim 
the second crown. She couldn't afford to 
fall behind. Hishi Amazon gears up for her 
next challenge: the Shuka Sho!
